resources.string: Two ways to reach 15%. Learned from your phone.
Battery is already at or below 15%.
Learning needs at least six clean 1% drops for each screen mode. Leave learning on during everyday use; longer uninterrupted sessions help.
Early estimates. Some battery levels use your overall average until more history is available.
Estimated time if the screen stays in that state. Screen-off audio intervals are excluded from learning.
Estimates describe use after unplugging. Charging does not train the model.
Uses battery, screen and audio events with a quiet notification. Automatically resumes after restart once you unlock your phone. Pausing keeps learning off.
Learning could not start. Open the app and try again.
Touch and hold your home screen, choose Widgets, then Battery Time.

Stored on this phone. Export includes current estimates, eight weeks of daily summaries and seven days of raw intervals. Older data is deleted automatically. Import replaces the current history; use a backup from this phone for relevant estimates.
Retained learning samples: %1$d. Raw intervals: %2$d. Import will replace all current history. Export first if you want to keep it. Expired records are discarded and estimates are recalculated.
Data could not be saved. Open the app to retry.

Daily means in 5% bands, with a 14-day half-life and eight-week limit. Sparse bands borrow the same screen mode’s mean. Coverage measures the remaining battery range with at least three effective samples on two days. Screen-off audio, mixed states, charging, jumps and uncertain intervals do not train either model. Audio detection depends on Android playback reports; remote or unreported playback cannot be guaranteed.
